'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russo-Ukrainian War]]
**[[2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***[[Battle of Donbas (2022)|Donbas offensive]], [[Eastern Ukraine offensive]]
****[[Battle of Sievierodonetsk (2022)|Battle of Sievierodonetsk]]
*****[[Russian Ground Forces|Russian troops]] enter the strategic city of [[Sievierodonetsk]] in [[Luhansk Oblast]] with heavy street-to-street fighting underway. Luhansk governor [[Serhiy Haidai]] says that [[Ukrainian Ground Forces|Ukrainian forces]] may have to retreat from the city in order to avoid capture. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/ukraine-says-troops-may-retreat-eastern-region-russia-advances-2022-05-28/ (Reuters)]
***[[List of military aid to Ukraine during the Russo-Ukrainian War|Foreign aid to Ukraine during the Russo-Ukrainian War]]
****[[Ukraine]] confirms that it has received shipments of [[Harpoon (missile)|Harpoon]] [[anti-ship missile]]s from [[Denmark]], and [[self-propelled artillery|self-propelled howitzers]] from the [[United States]] in order to counter the Russian invasion. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/ukraine-receives-harpoon-missiles-howitzers-says-defence-minister-2022-05-28/ (Reuters)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2022 Port Harcourt stampede]]
**Thirty-one people are killed and seven others are injured in a [[stampede]] at a [[Christianity in Nigeria|church]] charity event in [[Port Harcourt]], [[Rivers State]], [[Nigeria]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/5/28/deadly-stampede-at-a-church-in-nigeria (Al Jazeera)]
*[[2022 Brazil floods and landslides]]
**At least 106 people are killed by [[mudflow|mudslides]] and flooding in the [[Recife metropolitan area]], [[Pernambuco]], [[Brazil]]. [https://apnews.com/article/floods-jair-bolsonaro-politics-caribbean-climate-and-environment-d54657a2ed69f3bc8e75a828401469c3 (AP)]
*[[Indonesia]]n rescuers search for 26 people who went missing after a boat [[capsize]]d last Thursday in the [[Makassar Strait]] with 43 people on board. News of the sinking reached authorities today. [https://www.dawn.com/news/amp/1691915 (Dawn)] 
*Fifteen people are killed and three others are missing after heavy rain causes [[flood]]ing in southern [[China]]. [https://apnews.com/article/storms-china-climate-and-environment-059b90c71d81878eb4a537391fd93097 (AP)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[2022 monkeypox outbreak]]
**The [[Republic of Ireland]], [[Malta]], and [[Mexico]] confirm their first cases of [[monkeypox]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2022/may/28/first-case-monkeypox-confirmed-ireland (''The Guardian'')] [https://english.news.cn/20220528/bf3f899746f54dff9efdf2d386ea1506/c.html (Xinhua News Agency)] [https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/nacion/viruela-del-mono-confirman-primer-caso-en-mexico (''El Universal'' in Spanish)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2023 Nigerian presidential election]]
**Former [[Vice President of Nigeria|Vice President]] [[Atiku Abubakar]] wins the [[2023 Nigerian presidential election#Peoples Democratic Party|presidential primary]] of the main opposition [[Peoples Democratic Party (Nigeria)|Peoples Democratic Party]] and officially becomes the party's nominee for the February 2023 general election. Abubakar, who served as Vice President from 1999 to 2007 and was the PDP's 2019 presidential nominee, defeated [[Nyesom Wike]], [[Bukola Saraki]], and nine other candidates to win the primary. [https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/headlines/533251-breaking-again-atiku-emerges-pdp-presidential-candidate.html (''Premium Times'')]
*[[2019–2022 Sudanese protests]]
**Two [[protest]]ers are killed by [[Sudan]]ese [[security forces]] in [[Khartoum]]. [https://apnews.com/article/politics-middle-east-africa-sudan-united-nations-05fab8f3aee4136ec7e4c6aeeef1c191 (AP)]
*[[International sanctions during the Russo-Ukrainian War]]
**[[China]] denies airspace to [[Boeing]] and [[Airbus]] aircraft that have been reregistered in Russia as a result of sanctions triggered by [[2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine|its invasion]]. The reregistration is in violation of international law. [https://airwaysmag.com/china-closes-airspace-russia/ (Airways Magazine)]

'''Sports'''
*[[2021–22 UEFA Champions League]]
**In [[association football]], [[Real Madrid CF|Real Madrid]] win a [[European Cup and UEFA Champions League records and statistics|record]] 14th [[UEFA Champions League]] title after defeating [[Liverpool F.C.|Liverpool]] 1–0 in the [[2022 UEFA Champions League Final]] at the [[Stade de France]] near [[Paris]], with [[Vinícius Júnior]] scoring the winning goal. Kick-off was delayed by 36 minutes due to ticketed fans being prevented from entering the stadium. French police fire [[tear gas]] at Liverpool supporters. [[UEFA]] blamed the delay on Liverpool fans trying to enter the stadium with fake tickets and blocking the turnstiles. [https://www.theguardian.com/football/2022/may/28/champions-league-final-kick-off-delay-liverpool-real-madrid-paris (''The Guardian'')] [https://www.telegraph.co.uk/football/2022/05/28/liverpool-vs-real-madrid-live-score-champions-league-final-20221/ (''The Telegraph'')] [https://apnews.com/article/russia-ukraine-soccer-sports-france-champions-league-43fcca29e342210069c4000bde2b0a81 (AP)]
